parameters.help_en:
The number pool key.

To obtain the number pool key, go to the Number pool management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number Privacy Protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en: The intermediate number X. If the service consumer does not specify number X, the application platform assigns a number from the number pool as number X
parameters.help_zh: 中间号X。业务使用方未指定X号码时，由应用平台从号码池中指定一个号码作为X号码
parameters.name: telx

parameters.help_en: The order ID. This parameter is required in practice. Encrypt the order ID for reporting to the regulatory platform
parameters.help_zh: 订单 ID(实际上必填， 建议客户进行订单号加密，用于报送监管平台)
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: Optional. The Industrial Internet identification code, which has a one-to-one mapping with the OrderID. The code supports characters such as periods (.) and forward slashes (/) to separate code domains. The code must not contain non-printable characters, such as spaces or line feeds. This field is required when the service consumer generates the Industrial Internet identification code
parameters.help_zh:
可选工业互联网标识编码，与OrderID保持一一对应关系。编码支持“.”、“/”等字符分割编码域，编码中不得含有不可显示类字符，如空格符、换行符等。
当业务使用方自行生成工业互联网标识编码时，该字段必选
parameters.name: industrial_id
